title: No offline feature
review_text: This app was good with offline feature  When we are out of balance with no wifi available then how can we recharge now?? I would have given 5 stars if you had included offline feature...

author: Adbinod
title: Buggy update
review_text: There were back to back 2 updates but the  ‘app data needs to be cleared’ error is not yet resolved. The SMS version is probably better in context of nepal where there is no internet coverage everywhere. And the asking for mobile number for logging in at the beginning isn’t that necessary and useful as everyone has their PIN. What the developer needs to do is make the app ask for users which method do they want to proceed with.
